relationship: Additional arm, preserving the original ordered four-point results. Excludes padding an effective two-point decomposition with a cancelling pair.
factor_base_and_natural_targets: Identical deterministic curve/base/natural-target fixtures to protocol.json; 32 natural targets per curve.
acceptance: All four returned abscissae must be distinct. MITM searches every stored candidate pair; independent reference enumerates unordered quadruples with all four distinct abscissae. Exact point sum must match.
positive_control: One sum of four first available distinct-abscissa base points per eligible curve. Ineligible bases are recorded rather than replaced.
claim_ceiling: Toy constrained decomposition cells, operation counters in separate units; no lattice method or security conclusion.
